standard_lessons.full_text:
IV.A. Maneuver Lesson
The evaluator asks the applicant to present a preflight lesson on the selected maneuver as the lesson would be taught to a student and determines the outcome of this Task before the flight portion of the practical test. Previously developed lesson plans from the instructor applicant's library may be used.
All necessary information for this lesson is found in sections VII through XII
ACS Requirements:
The applicant demonstrates instructional knowledge by describing and explaining:
Purpose of the maneuver.
Elements of the maneuvers and the associated common errors.
Desired outcome(s), including completion standards.
Deliver instruction on the selected maneuver using a lesson plan, teaching methods, and teaching aids, as appropriate.
